bio.text: Deb Fischer was first elected to the U.S. Senate from Nebraska in November 2012 and was re-elected in 2018 and 2024.
She represented Nebraska's 43rd Legislative District in the Nebraska Unicameral from 2005 to 2013.
Born and raised in Lincoln, she graduated from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln with a degree in education.
She and her husband Bruce operate a ranching business in the Nebraska Sandhills.
